messages:
Avery: Quick copy sync — trying to lock messaging for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages + a webinar hook that feeds our inbound routing. Goal: one hero that speaks to predictable inference economics, then 3 micro-journeys (self-serve, reserved capacity, private). Draft doc: https://docs.google.com/example-copy-draft (please comment). TL;DR: keep 'predictable inference' as core, but call out 'cost controls' for Hosted, 'committed throughput' for Dedicated, 'network & compliance controls' for Private. Add any deal-breakers or risky claims you see.

Rae: +1. For launch posts we need punchy headlines. Two rapid options from social tests: "Scale inference, not bill shock" vs "Predictable inference at scale". Leaning to the first — feels more tactical. Webinar hook idea: "Webinar: Cut inference cost and keep latency SLOs". Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Miguel: Data note — our bench numbers are solid but variable by model/seq len. Avoid absolute claims like "3x cheaper" unless we qualify with typical workload. Suggest copy: "Reduce per-token cost with workload-aware optimizations (typical savings up to 3x)". Legal will want the qualifier.

Sam: I'll draft H1/H2 + three CTAs. Proposed microcopy (will iterate):
```
H1: Predictable inference for production apps
H2: Fast, cost-aware serving whether you want hosted endpoints, reserved GPU capacity, or private deployments.
CTA A: Start free (Hosted) -> /signup?utm_campaign=launch_v1
CTA B: Get Dedicated pricing -> /contact-dedicated
CTA C: Private deployment inquiry -> /enterprise/private-contact
```
Can someone 👍 the CTA destinations? Also thinking about a short 45-min webinar subtitle: "How to cut inference cost without sacrificing latency".

Jules: Design constraints: hero needs visual affordances for the three modes — small toggle or three pills. Also we should surface one benchmark stat in the hero (e.g., median P95 latency for small models) not a % savings. Ops: add experiment flag for the hero variant A/B. Use utm params: utm_campaign=copy_launch_v1, utm_source=org_tweet.

Nora: For Private page please add an FAQ line about air-gapped/on-prem: short snippet like "On-prem and air-gapped options with KMS/HSM support" — saves a support ticket. Also we should call out compliance badges (SOC2 / ISO) in that section.

Rae: I'll own the launch post + webinar announcement thread. Quick ask: who will sign off on benchmark language? Miguel / Legal? I can tag Legal once we have the exact phrasing.

Miguel: I'll compile the baseline numbers and propose a single hero stat we can use; will send by EOD. Legal: please standby for a small review.

Sam: First draft inbound by EOD. Will post as a doc comment thread with inline H1/H2 variants and alt CTAs.

Avery: Great — cadence: review tomorrow 11:00AM PT (copy + design). Rae, you'll run the webinar signup funnel mapping? If yes I'll slot you as lead.

Rae: Yup I'll map funnel and mapping to inbound routing (self-serve signup -> marketing nurture; dedicated -> AE outreach; private -> sales-eng). Will create routing matrix after Miguel's numbers.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: New doc created in marketing start folder: https://drive.google.com/example-copy-draft (created by Avery)

Jules: small nit — hero animations should not impact LCP; keep the three cards as static for first paint, animate later via intersection observer.

Avery: Thanks all. Action items: Sam draft by EOD, Miguel benchmark stat, Rae funnel mapping, Jules hero static for first paint, Nora add Private FAQ blurb. We'll reconvene 11AM PT tomorrow. :rocket:
